en.headline: Firefighters extinguish smoke at Aberdeen Centre supermarket kitchen, no injuries
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the blaze at the ParknShop on Nam Ning Street had been put out by the time crews arrived around 11am on Sunday.
body: Firefighters attended a supermarket at Aberdeen Centre on Sunday morning after reports of thick smoke, but found the fire had already been extinguished on arrival and no one was injured.

The incident was reported at about 11:03am at the ParknShop on the ground floor of Aberdeen Centre on Nam Ning Street in the Southern District. Initial reports suggested the fire started at a stove in the supermarket’s kitchen.
The Fire Services Department said crews arrived to find the fire out, with only residual smoke remaining. There was no need to evacuate the premises, and the cause is under investigation.

zh.headline: 香港仔中心超市廚房冒濃煙 消防到場火已熄無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處指南寧街13至23號百佳超級市場今早約11時接報，到場時火勢已熄，只剩殘煙，無人受傷亦毋須疏散。
body: 星期日早上，香港仔中心一間超級市場傳出濃煙，消防員接報到場後發現火已熄掉，事件中無人受傷。
事件發生在港島南區南寧街13至23號香港仔中心地下的百佳超級市場，今早約11時03分接報。初步來料顯示超市廚房爐頭失火。
消防處表示，消防員到場時火勢已被救熄，只剩下部分濃煙。事件毋須疏散人士，火警原因仍有待調查。
